# Renaming map (generated by tools/design_docs.py; do not edit by hand)

The complete map from the names of commit ee37ef1 (pathways v3.1) to the MODEL v1.0.0 names. Sections 2-5 are enumerated from every identifier of the captured outputs (tests/regression_model_v1.json) through `naming.LEGACY`, the same map tests/test_regression_model_v1.py uses to find every captured number in the release outputs; nothing in them is typed by hand.

**Principle.** Every term is academically proper, describes its content and is concise; one vocabulary everywhere. Internal code may use short IDs; everything a reader sees uses the labels below.

## 1. Vocabulary

Reader-facing labels (figures, tables, captions, documents) come only from `naming.py`. Code may use the short IDs; data files use the IDs with ASCII hyphens (no en dash) so that every tool reads them.

### Projection and variants

| code ID | release label | v3.1 names | definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REF` | Reference | `S3-10` (also run P0, "central run", "reference S3-10") | the adopted projection with no interventions: net replacement fades from the 2018–2023 census-interval rate to the 1991–2023 long-run rate with a 10-year half-life |
| `LOW` | Low replacement | `S1` | sensitivity variant of the Reference: the 1991–2023 long-run net replacement rate throughout |
| `HIGH` | High replacement | `S2` | sensitivity variant of the Reference: the 2018–2023 census-interval rate persists |
| `REF_HL5` | Reference, replacement half-life 5 yr | `S3-5` | sensitivity variant |
| `REF_HL15` | Reference, replacement half-life 15 yr | `S3-15` | sensitivity variant |
| `LOW_NOUC` | Low replacement, no census under-construction correction | `S1-noUC` | sensitivity variant |
| `REF_NOUC` | Reference, no census under-construction correction | `S3-10-noUC` | sensitivity variant |
| `HIGH_NOUC` | High replacement, no census under-construction correction | `S2-noUC` | sensitivity variant |

Frozen-technology check run: "Frozen technology (2025 carbon factors held; check run)" (data/frozen_technology/).

In the pathway tables the run without interventions takes the ID of its variant: REF (was P0 under S3-10), LOW (P0 under S1), HIGH (P0 under S2). "P0" is not used in any reader-facing text.

### Demand bands (bottom to top)

| ID | release label | v3.1 labels | definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `growth` | Population growth | "Growth (net of consolidation)"; "Growth demand (net of consolidation)" | population growth at the occupied area per person, net of consolidation (untargeted) |
| `smaller_households` | Smaller households | "House-splitting"; "House-splitting demand" | additional households from falling household size (untargeted) |
| `extra_space` | Extra space | "Extra space per dwelling"; "Consumption: extra space per dwelling" | new-dwelling size above the occupied area (household size x floor area per design occupant) |
| `vacancy` | Vacancy | "Vacancy allowance"; "Consumption: vacancy allowance" | the vacancy allowance on new households and the change in the vacancy rate |
| `overbuild_2026` | 2026 overbuild | "Near-term market excess"; "Near-term market excess (2026 observed building above requirement, fading at rho)" | observed 2026 building above the requirement, fading at the persistence rho; never absorbed |
| `replacement` | Historical replacement | "Replacement: long-run background (net of unconsented additions)" | the long-run net replacement rate: demolition net of unconsented additions, 1991–2023 ratio of sums of the census dwelling-count identity (the census identifies only their sum) |
| `redevelopment` | Recent replacement surge | "Redevelopment wave (scenario - long run)"; "Replacement: recent redevelopment wave (fading)" | the scenario rate above that long-run rate: the 2018–2023 knock-down-and-rebuild wave, fading in the Reference |
| `maintenance` | Maintenance (B2, B4), 2026–2050 | "Replacements & repaints, within 2026-2050" | replacement and repaint events (B2, B4) of the new buildings within 2026–2050 (carbon only) |
| `replacement_demolition` | Historical replacement: demolition (BRANZ rate) | "Demolition replacement" | sub-row of Historical replacement in data tables |
| `replacement_residual` | Historical replacement: net unconsented additions (calibrated residual) | "Calibrated stock residual (long run)" | sub-row of Historical replacement in data tables |
| `retirement_villages` | Retirement villages (out of scope) | "Housed in RV units (out of scope)" | bookkeeping row, out of scope; not a band in figures |
| `replacement_history` | Net replacement (history; historical replacement and recent surge not separable) |  | history band (census intervals, H3): historical replacement and the recent surge are not separable before 2026 |

### Terms

| v3.1 term | release term |
|---|---|
| within-window, within the window, in-window | 2026–2050 (e.g. "carbon 2026–2050", "maintenance (B2, B4), 2026–2050") |
| S3-10, reference S3-10, central run, P0, baseline (as a run) | Reference |
| S1, Low (S1) | Low replacement |
| S2, High (S2) | High replacement |
| S3-5, S3-15 | Reference, replacement half-life 5 yr / 15 yr |
| -noUC | , no census under-construction correction |
| central / stretch | Moderate / Ambitious |
| ramp, logistic ramp, ramp2035 / ramp2030 / ramp2045 | adoption path; full roll-out by 2035 (adopted) / by 2030 / by 2045 |
| instant start, T at full strength from 2027 | full strength from 2027 |
| near-term market excess, near-term join, near-term surplus | 2026 overbuild |
| house-splitting | smaller households |
| growth (net of consolidation), growth demand | population growth |
| extra space per dwelling, consumption: extra space | extra space |
| vacancy allowance, consumption: vacancy | vacancy |
| demolition replacement + calibrated stock residual; long-run background replacement | historical replacement (net of unconsented additions; MODEL v1.1.0, was "replacement" in model-v1.0.0) |
| redevelopment wave | recent replacement surge (MODEL v1.1.0, was "redevelopment" in model-v1.0.0) |
| replacements & repaints (B2, B4) within 2026-2050 | maintenance (B2, B4), 2026–2050 |
| upfront (A1-A5 + soil) | materials and construction (A1–A5) + soil carbon loss (both named); "upfront" kept only as the defined sum in data files |
| soil (land-use change) | soil carbon loss |
| committed post-2050 emissions | committed after 2050 (later B2/B4 and C1–C4) |
| PB layer, planetary-boundary layer | planetary-boundary layer (AESA); data and file prefix "aesa" |
| T, theoretical limit T, T-ramp | TL Theoretical limit; TL, gradual adoption (SI) |
| L4 (denser typology mix, pathways_v2) | denser typology mix (lever of pathways_v2, removed in pathways_v3.1) (never numbered: L4 is Building retention) |
| version tags in labels (v1.1, v1.2, baseline-pb-v3, PATHWAYS v2, v3, v3.1) | none in any label, caption or generated document (history: CHANGELOG and git tags) |
| typology (Detached, Townhouses, Apartments) in reporting | not reported; typology stays internal to the model (factors and lever parameters in data/) |

### Vacancy wording (one sentence everywhere)

> the vacancy-rate parameter is held at its published 2023 census value (5.39%; on the consistent definition 2023 is the series maximum, 5.38%, minimum 4.01% in 1996); implied stock vacancy rises to ≈6.4% because the 2026 overbuild is not absorbed.

Values are read from the overbuild report (outputs/near_term_join.json at ee37ef1; data/baseline/overbuild_2026.json in the release): the held rate is the published 2023 empty-dwelling share; on the consistent definition (the pooled 2018/2023 empty share applied to every census) 2023 is the highest census and 1996 the lowest. Every document, caption and code comment that implies that vacancy itself stays at the census level is reworded to this sentence.

## 7. Axis labels and legend entries

Axis labels follow one pattern: quantity (unit), e.g. "Floor area (Mm² per year)", "Embodied carbon (kt CO₂e per year)", "Cumulative level of exceedance, 2026–2050". Every v3.1 axis label of the figure audit records and its release form:

| v3.1 axis label | release axis label |
|---|---|
| Population (persons) | Population (million) |
| Households (millions) | Households (million) |
| People per Household / persons per household | Household size (persons per household) |
| Per year (persons; households) | Persons or households per year (thousand) |
| Cumulative new GFA (Mm²) | Floor area, cumulative (Mm²) |
| Annual new GFA (Mm²/yr) / Mm² per year | Floor area (Mm² per year) |
| Mm² / Mm² (2026-2050) | Floor area 2026–2050 (Mm²) |
| Mm² per year (log) | Floor area (Mm² per year, log scale) |
| Annual carbon (kt CO₂e per year) / kt CO₂e per year / kt CO$_2$e per year | Embodied carbon (kt CO₂e per year) |
| Cumulative carbon (kt CO₂e) / cumulative kt CO$_2$e / kt CO₂e, cumulative from 2026 | Embodied carbon, cumulative from 2026 (kt CO₂e) |
| kt CO₂e / kt CO₂e, 2026-2050 | Embodied carbon 2026–2050 (kt CO₂e) |
| kt CO₂e per year (log scale) | Boundary (kt CO₂e per year, log scale) |
| LoE = annual carbon / boundary (log scale) | Level of exceedance (annual carbon / boundary, log scale) |
| change in cumulative LoE vs reference (…) | Change in cumulative level of exceedance vs the Reference |
| cumulative level of exceedance 2026-2050 (log) | Cumulative level of exceedance, 2026–2050 (log scale) |
| % change from the adopted settings | Change vs the Reference (%) |
| % difference from adopted, each year | Difference vs the Reference, each year (%) |
| % of private dwellings / vacancy (% of private dwellings) | Vacancy rate (% of private dwellings) |
| % of last year's stock per year | Net replacement (% of the previous year's stock per year) |
| % of floor area / GFA Market Share (%) / townhouses + apartments, % of floor area | removed (by-typology reporting) |
| m² per dwelling | Floor area per dwelling (m²) |
| m² per person | Floor area per person (m²) |
| kg CO₂e per m² / kg CO₂e per m² of new floor area (log) | Carbon intensity (kg CO₂e per m², log scale where stated) |
| t CO₂e per new dwelling (log) | Carbon per new dwelling (t CO₂e, log scale) |
| Utilisation: S / design capacity (%) | Occupancy utilisation: household size / design capacity (%) |
| thousand dwellings / dwellings per year / thousand per year | Dwellings (thousand per year) |
| dwellings consented | Dwellings consented |
| households per consent | Households per consent |
| population growth that year (thousand) | Population growth (thousand per year) |
| change in household size | Change in household size (persons per household) |
| index, 2025 = 1 | Index (2025 = 1) |
| % change from previous year / number of years | Change from the previous year (%) / Number of years |
| share of output variance | Share of output variance |
| Year / year | Year (only where the axis is not obviously calendar years) |
| million / thousand / persons | quantity named with its unit (e.g. "Dwellings (million)") |

Legend entries (term level; legends are composed from the vocabulary above):

| v3.1 legend entry | release legend entry |
|---|---|
| Historical (ERP, 31 Dec) | History (estimated resident population, 31 December) |
| Projected Median | Reference projection (median) |
| Uncertainty (5th/95th) | Population 5th-95th percentile |
| Projected Total GFA (Median) | Reference projection |
| Population 5th-95th percentile (other inputs fixed) | Population 5th-95th percentile (other inputs at the Reference) |
| reference MC 5-95% | Monte Carlo 5-95% (Reference) |
| Boss central run | Reference (deterministic) |
| Monte Carlo median | Monte Carlo median |
| Total built, in scope | removed (bands sum to the total) |
| boundary, acquired rights (AR) / B_AR (acquired rights) | Acquired rights (AR) |
| boundary, ability to pay (AtP) / B_AtP (ability to pay) | Ability to pay (AtP) |
| LoE = 1 (boundary) | LoE = 1 |
| Reference without in-window replacements & repaints | Reference without maintenance (B2, B4) |
| within 2026-2050: upfront at construction | Materials and construction (A1–A5) + soil carbon loss, 2026–2050 |
| within 2026-2050: replacements & repaints | Maintenance (B2, B4), 2026–2050 |
| committed after 2050 (later replacements & repaints + end of life), lower bound | Committed after 2050, lower bound (2050 factors held) |
| committed after 2050, range to the upper bound (2025 factors) | Committed after 2050, range to the upper bound (2025 factors) |
| P0 / P0 baseline | Reference |
| P5-central / P5-stretch | P5 Combined, Moderate / Ambitious |
| T theoretical limit / T (limit) / T-ramp | TL Theoretical limit / TL, gradual adoption |
| central (open) / stretch (filled) | Moderate (open) / Ambitious (filled) |
| full by 2030 / 2035 (adopted) / 2045 | full roll-out by 2030 / by 2035 (adopted) / by 2045 |
| Soil (land-use change) | Soil carbon loss |
| history (built) | History (built) |
| Detached / Townhouses / Apartments | removed (by-typology reporting) |

## 10. MODEL v1.1.0 renaming

Two demand bands renamed (labels only; IDs, definitions of the quantities and every number unchanged). The data labels of the bands follow (naming.band_data_label); the model-v1.0.0 additions captured with the old labels are mapped by naming.BAND_RELABEL_V1_1. tests/test_release.py greps every reader-facing text for the old names (naming.OLD_TERMS).

| ID | model-v1.0.0 label | MODEL v1.1.0 label | definition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `replacement` | Replacement | Historical replacement | the long-run net replacement rate: demolition net of unconsented additions, 1991–2023 ratio of sums of the census dwelling-count identity (the census identifies only their sum) |
| `redevelopment` | Redevelopment | Recent replacement surge | the scenario rate above that long-run rate: the 2018–2023 knock-down-and-rebuild wave, fading in the Reference |
| `replacement_demolition` | Replacement: demolition (BRANZ rate) | Historical replacement: demolition (BRANZ rate) |  |
| `replacement_residual` | Replacement: net unconsented additions (calibrated residual) | Historical replacement: net unconsented additions (calibrated residual) |  |
| `replacement_history` | Replacement and redevelopment (history; not separable) | Net replacement (history; historical replacement and recent surge not separable) |  |
